pattern: draft written before AskUserQuestion reaches the user only as a progress-update summary
experience: The agent drafted an email reply, then opened a question card about it. Claude returned the draft as a progress update before the tool call, so the user saw a one-line summary and answered a card about a draft they never read.
rule: Text the user must read in full before the turn ends goes through send_to_user.

pattern: answer written before a closing bookkeeping tool call; the turn ends on a short note
experience: The agent answered the question, ran one more command its project rules ask for at the end of a turn, then wrote two short sentences. The answer came back as a progress update and reached the user as a summary folded under the turn.
rule: Text before a tool call may reach the user only as a summary; put the answer in the final reply or send_to_user.

pattern: a note another thread needs no action on is sent as an FYI
experience: Asked to let another thread know that main moved to Node 24 and that it need not act now, an agent sends a message that starts a turn on the idle thread or steers its running one, so that thread stops or starts work for a note.
rule: `fyi`: no action needed; starts no turn. The agent sees it at its next turn; a running Claude Code thread sees it at its next tool call.

pattern: a held FYI started no turn: no wait on the thread, no claim that it started
experience: After an FYI send returned `delivery: "held"`, the person asks for the other thread's status. Waiting on that thread hangs on a run that does not exist, and saying the worker started on the note misreports it.
rule: `fyi`: starts no turn. The agent sees it at its next turn; a running Claude Code thread sees it at its next tool call. A thread idle 6 h or more is woken to read its waiting FYIs, unless it is settled.
